basis: Individually inspected half-open instruction spans, canonical complex records and prepared scalar settings. Scalar callees are not included implicitly. Numeric scratch RAM equivalence and malformed BCD behavior are not claimed. Understanding is independent of full firmware completion.

ranges.scope: Complete complex add/subtract/multiply/divide wrappers, copied real-marker normalization, ordered component products/numerators, numerical error normalization, scalar workspace helpers and reciprocal/square/cube wrappers with original-before-stored-square cube order; scalar callees excluded
Component division chooses integer-ratio rational construction only when both ordinary decimal headers are below ten; otherwise ordinary scalar division, preserving native numerical status

Scalar zero/negative/positive/domain classification before metadata clearing, compact-surd coefficient-sign selection and mixed-sign decimal conversion that deliberately bypasses the ordinary zero test
Shared scalar classification return preserves its result while restoring saved registers
Complex negation in imaginary-then-real order, early nonzero imaginary error status, F0 zero-code continuation and component addressing

Polar/rectangular conversion wrappers: operand guards, radius sign policy, ordered special-result sin/cos multiplication, magnitude/argument composition, dual F3 normalization and native successful zero-axis F3-radius/angle pairs
Restricted complex exponent selector, conjugation and early real-error branch including incoming ER4-selected imaginary reset
Argument scalar preparation, ordered atan2 call and imaginary reset
Ordered per-component cleanup, distinct real versus imaginary error normalization branches and F0 zero-code continuation

Canonical atan2: zero/error guards, mandatory stored y/x before inverse tangent reciprocal, quadrant reconstruction, signed output and quarter-turn unit selection; scalar arithmetic/trig callees excluded

Complex magnitude: scalar absolute preprocessing, zero components and their forced-success status, safe square raw exponent interval, decimal squared sum and exact-root recognition; large/tiny or compact-cancellation-zero components use smaller/larger ratio, root then ordered scale multiplication
Scalar absolute component preparation, sign classification, header40 clearing and domain/error replacement
Scalar output preprocessing: surd conversion before header guard, marked rational rejection, metadata clearing and ordinary rational conversion status

Prepared display-precision rounding: Norm ten digits, Sci zero-to-ten precision, Fix fractional-part short circuit then multiply/integral-round/divide order; imaginary-first CMPLX wrapper and early native error return

Restricted CMPLX square root: native zero-class imaginary admission (compact cancellation remains rejected), scalar real surd conversion before sign classification, positive real root or positive imaginary root for negative real, explicit exact-output permission and forced-success post-admission return
Prepared CMPLX power selects full real power only when both imaginary components have native class 1, otherwise the restricted complex selector; callees are not included implicitly

Imaginary zero classification; raw imaginary header selects reciprocal fallback; scalar versus complex arithmetic entries; multiplying by exactly i rotates the records, clears the new imaginary marker and forces leaf success

Post-leaf context cleanup and evaluator status: nonzero leaf bypass, CMPLX compact real surd skip, marked real decimal cleans only real, other CMPLX pairs clean both, scalar contexts skip tagged headers

Operand admission bits: immediate real error rejection, mask 255 bypass, DMS and marked fraction rejection, real-only admission using the raw imaginary exponent/sign word for ordinary decimal, rational and surd types
Imaginary-unit input value 40 copies zero real and one imaginary, bypassing ordinary literal imaginary zero initialization
